title: Scandinavian Defense: Modern Variation
line: Black takes the pawn back later with a knight, and the knight settles in front of White's pawns.

steps.text: Bring the knight out. It will take back on d5.

also.d8d5: That is the main line, and just as sound. This lesson takes back later with the knight.

steps.text: Take the pawn back with the knight.
White's pawn hits your knight. Step back to b6.

also.d5f6: That also works. This lesson steps back to b6.

steps.text: Push the pawn on g7 one square, to make room for your bishop.
Put the bishop on g7. It aims at the pawn on d4.
steps.after: White's pawn kicks your knight again.

steps.text: Jump back to d5. White's pawns have moved past it, so no pawn can kick it from there.
Push the pawn on c7 one square. It guards the knight on d5.
Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.
steps.after: Your knight sits on d5, guarded by a pawn, in front of White's pawns, and the bishop on g7 aims at d4.

summary: In the Modern Variation the knight takes back later, White's pawns chase it, and it settles in front of them.
